    InitSystemService
    Init-system abstraction for the LFS/BLFS system managers: it detects which service supervisor the running system uses (systemd, openrc, runit, s6 or plain sysvinit) and maps a logical service operation onto that supervisor's native command line.

    The service supervisors this desktop knows how to drive.

    The verdict of a lfs-update check, derived from its exit code.

    NetworkService
    Network-manager abstraction for the LFS/BLFS system managers: it detects which network backend the running system uses (NetworkManager, dhcpcd, systemd-networkd, or a read-only ip fallback) and maps a logical connection/link operation onto that backend's native command line.

    The network backends this desktop knows how to drive.

    One parsed network row: a connection or link name, its type, a best-effort state string (may be empty) and an active flag.
    NetworkService.Operation
    A logical network operation, mapped per backend.
    NetworkService.Probes
    The PATH facts NetworkService.detect(Probes) needs.
    Opener
    Opens files, folders and URIs with the user's preferred applications and moves files to the trash, using the freedesktop.org conventions.
